Shaped iteration 0099 as one bounded research task in [tasks.json](tasks.json).
The task reconciles all-version versus LabVIEW 2024 effort with creation, modification, source rebuilds and save-version preservation.
The [historical estimate](../docs/research/0002-delivery.md) covers reading and contains unverified version-range assumptions; its totals cannot represent the expanded goal.
The researcher must distinguish observations, estimates and unknowns, retaining indeterminate totals where evidence is insufficient.
Expected outputs are `docs/research/0099-writing-version-effort.md` and its evidence JSON, plus one concrete follow-up measurement.
Assigned researcher/default/high, 90 minutes, 55 turns; no dependencies, with report #493 exported.
Recorded reviewer #497’s closure of allocator finding #443.1 in [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md).
Its [trusted report](reports/497.json) identifies pinned bytes, passing ordinary checks and six rejected mutations; this remains synthetic evidence.
Updated working memory with open threads, deferral reasons and cold-session instructions.
Read the saved graph back once and inspected its JSON structure, allowed role/options, sections and verification command; no shell validation was available.
No LabVIEW execution, product implementation, benchmark-readiness claim or fallback selection occurred.

## What next
Execute `writing-version-effort`, then read its actual report and both outputs before selecting the next measurement.
Independently review the estimate before using it to propose a fallback; avoid repeating closed reviews or the unsuccessful POC corpus search.
